title.narrative: Financial management and monitoring support to CIMI and Caritas Tefe - to support EU project BRA557

description.narrative:
This consultant contract is to support the financial monitoring and accounting management of the CIMI and Caritas Tefé EU project, BRA557, due to start in July 2016. This consultancy will be performed from May 2016 - April 2017, using online communication (Skype, email and whatsapp) and telephone to provide the guidance and support needed to partners, and will not involve travel to Tefe. CIMI and Caritas will receive a visit from the project's auditor in May 2016 to evaluate the organisation's financial systems and procedures, after which the recommendations will be implemented with the support at a distance of this consultant. The main activities will involve the following:
a) Guidance, advice and training to partners for the preparation of systems, monitoring and financial controls of the project funded by the EU and CAFOD, supporting the coordination and the management team of the project and partners in financial management and controls and accounting and human resources of the Project. b) support the planning and implementation of activities with financial and accounting information, promoting an updated financial monitoring and financial and accounting control of the project, including supervision. c) To contribute to the capacity building of partners in financial management and accounting monitoring, and when necessary guiding, monitoring and seeking tax / financial and calculations related to labour legislation. d) Assist the partners and local consultant in the preparation of budgets and interim financial reports, guiding administrators in the development and consolidation of same, and including justifications and supervising the preparation of quarterly, mid-year and annual financial reports. e) support for compliance with EU contractual rules - support the partners to ensure that all financial and administrative and financial procedures follow the rules of the contract with the EU, including the filing of the documentation required: (a) exemption from VAT on public bodies b) procedure of procurement of goods and services; c) Office costs - guidelines, d) monitoring of travel, fuel, etc. point leaves f) support the financial management of the partner organizations in financial and accounting matters, following the financial-accounting entries monthly and when necessary developing tools that facilitate and unify the financial information.
